Retrieve comprehensive user profile data and aggregated account information

items.docs: Returns detailed user profile information including account status, verification levels, biographical data, and associated metadata. This endpoint aggregates essential user information from multiple sources to provide a complete user profile overview.

info.name: Comprehensive search and analytics engine for user discovery and analysis

params.name: period
params.description: Defines the time period for analyzing user metrics and performance data. Supports various predefined intervals for consistent analysis.

params.name: isTestAccount
params.description: When set to true, filters results to include only test/demo accounts. When false, shows only live accounts. Optional filter.

params.name: optIn
params.description: Filter for users who have explicitly opted in to specific features or programs. Used for compliance and feature-specific filtering.

params.name: blocked
params.description: When true, includes only blocked accounts in the results. Used for compliance and risk management purposes.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for pagination.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of results per page.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort results by specific field (e.g., -copiers).

params.name: popularInvestor
params.description: Filter for popular investors.

params.name: gainMax
params.description: Max gain value filter.

params.name: maxDailyRiskScoreMin
params.description: Minimum daily risk score.

params.name: maxDailyRiskScoreMax
params.description: Maximum daily risk score.

params.name: maxMonthlyRiskScoreMin
params.description: Minimum monthly risk score.

params.name: maxMonthlyRiskScoreMax
params.description: Maximum monthly risk score.

params.name: weeksSinceRegistrationMin
params.description: Minimum weeks since registration.

params.name: countryId
params.description: The registered country ID of the user

params.name: instrumentId
params.description: The instrument ID (you can also use this to exclude an instrument e.g., -5).

params.name: instrumentPctMin
params.description: Minimum percentage of investment in the requested instrument ID.

params.name: instrumentPctMax
params.description: Maximum percentage of investment in the requested instrument ID.

items.docs: Powerful search platform that enables advanced user discovery with comprehensive filtering capabilities. Supports complex queries across multiple dimensions including performance metrics, risk profiles, investment patterns, and account characteristics. Ideal for identifying users based on specific trading behaviors and performance criteria.

info.name: Retrieve granular performance data for specific time periods

params.name: username
params.description: Unique identifier of the user whose performance data is being requested

params.name: minDate
params.description: Start date for the analysis period (inclusive) in YYYY-MM-DD format

params.name: maxDate
params.description: End date for the analysis period (inclusive) in YYYY-MM-DD format

params.name: type
params.description: Specifies the granularity of the performance data: 'Daily' for day-by-day metrics or 'Period' for aggregated period statistics

items.docs: Provides detailed performance analytics including daily gains, cumulative returns, and period-specific metrics within a specified date range. Supports various time-based analyses and performance reporting requirements.

info.name: Retrieve detailed historical performance metrics and analytics for a specified user

params.name: username
params.description: Unique identifier of the user whose performance metrics are being requested

items.docs: Returns comprehensive historical monthly and yearly performance data including gain percentages, risk-adjusted returns, and detailed trading statistics. This endpoint provides both aggregated and time-series performance metrics.

params.description: The username of the user to retrieve the live portfolio for.
